reviews.text: I'm a veterinarian and I was looking for a reliable daycare for my Pinky. Since finding this place, I've been very pleased that they have strict requirements, including a complete preventative care schedule to ensure everyone's well-being, as well as socialization beforehand to assess whether she was suitable to stay. I've left her there for boarding when I travel and for daycare, and I've even left her for baths, and everything has been EXCELLENT. Whenever we pass by, she wants to go in and play; she loves going and comes back tired but happy. I always recommend this option to my patients. Thank you so much for the excellent care. 🐾💛
Excellent service for pets, the dogs always arrive very happy 🫶🏼🐶
The place is quite untrustworthy; they have good marketing but terrible consistency with the services they offer outside the daycare.

Honestly, the best place to care for our furry friends. More than a daycare, it's like a family. We've been taking our little Blue there for almost two years now, and you can see how well they treat her. Ever since she arrived, she's been eager to go inside, and the Pets Plaza team is incredibly kind and attentive.

P.S. Here's a picture of her and how happy she is at Pet's Plaza.

The facilities are very nice, pleasant, clean, and well laid out, and above all, the fact that there's always a doctor nearby for our dogs is very important to me. The only thing I didn't see was an outdoor area. Dr. Mariana's care was excellent.

My dog ​​is the happiest when I take her! She socializes and plays a lot and comes home exhausted. Every time I take her, they send me photos and videos. It gives me so much peace of mind to leave my fur baby with them 💕 …

Excellent place.
The service is very good and responsible. We have been using their hairdressing, daycare, and boarding services for many years without any problems.
I left my kitten for the Christmas holidays and returned to find him doing great. They sent me photos and videos daily. Great place!

Chase and Kiki endorse them!
Excellent service, and I love the speed and high quality with which they do things!

I loved it!!! The service was excellent!! It's hard for me to find a good grooming salon because my dog ​​is very skittish and always leaves anxious and stressed, but I finally found the perfect place ♡♡♡ I've never seen her so happy and calm leaving the salon ♡♡♡ Thank you! ❤️

I enrolled my dog ​​in a school before PET Plaza, and it's nothing like the service and care they provide. They throw parties, pamper the dogs, and even have costume contests. I'm so happy to take her there.

I also love that you can choose which days to take her; you're not tied to the specific days or the "packages" they sell.
Total confidence! I've always left my pet there and I love the service.

Lola is always so happy at her daycare. They're always attentive to her and treat her with so much love. You can tell when they welcome her, and she gets so excited when she's arriving. They usually send photos of her every day, which is very reassuring. Dr. Mariana is always on top of her overall health and the special care she needs. I'm so grateful to Pets Plaza ☺️
Very good place, good service from the staff... The cost of their services is a little high, but overall it was good.
Great place! My dogs Fabricio and Lucrecia love Pets Plaza.
